about.welcome: Welcome to Shifa, where your health is our top priority. We offer a wide range of medical services, from general checkups to specialized treatments, all delivered with compassion and expertise.

services.title: Expert Medical Care for You & Your Family
services.subtitle: From emergency to telemedicine: complete healthcare at your fingertips.
services.emergencyDesc: Immediate ambulance, doctor & hospital assistance within 150km radius. Critical care response in minutes.
services.opdDesc: AYUSH-qualified & MBBS doctors. Book appointments at local clinics or home visits. ₹300-800 per consultation.
services.labTestsDesc: Home sample collection. NABL-certified labs. Reports in 24-48 hrs. Free home delivery in metro areas.
services.medicineDesc: Generic & branded medicines. Express delivery across India. Free shipping on orders above ₹500.
services.telemedicineDesc: Video consultation with doctors. First consultation FREE. Available 24/7. Prescription delivery included.
services.hospitalsDesc: Network of 500+ hospitals & clinics. Find beds, ICU availability, check prices in real-time. Direct booking.
services.ambulanceDesc: Basic/Advanced life support ambulances. GPS tracked. ₹500-2000. ACL certified drivers & paramedics.
services.bloodBankDesc: Find blood donors. Verified & screened. Delivery in 2 hrs + Rs. 1200-2000/unit. Emergency support available.
services.healthRecordsDesc: Your complete medical history. Encrypted cloud storage. Share with doctors instantly. HIPAA compliant.
